title: Tarpon Springs tied for 112th among Florida cities for scam reports in June
text:
Tarpon Springs tied for 112th among Florida cities for scam reports in June
Tarpon Springs was among 42 cities tied for 112th out of 237 Florida cities with at least one BBB Scam Tracker report in June 2026, recording two scam reports, according to Better Business Bureau.
That was an increase from one report in the previous month.
One report in June 2026 included a listed dollar amount, with reported losses totaling $119.95. The most frequent scam type was an online purchase, which made up one of the reports.
BBB Scam Tracker lets consumers search reported scams and share experiences to help others spot similar schemes. The BBB says it reviews each report before publication and does not publicly display the reporter’s name or personal contact information.
Fraud reports have continued to involve large financial losses nationwide. The Federal Trade Commission said consumers reported losing more than $12.5 billion to fraud in 2024, a 25% increase from the previous year.
